answer: Treat reward vesting as an oasis reachable only after a long walk: each new agent's earnings lock for 30 epochs and vest linearly, and if peers prove it is a sybil, the unvested balance is slashed. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must fund a month of real work per identity while risking every locked coin, so cheap clones stop paying. Honest balances build up like layered shale; sybil farms drift away like an unanchored dune.
